# Third-party components

JavaScript package copyrights and licenses are in ../THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt and the bundled .LEGAL.txt files. Radix UI, Fastdom, Strictdom and react-remove-scroll-bar licenses supplement packages which put license text outside a top-level LICENSE file.

Font metadata is preserved verbatim in font-metadata.json. Excalidraw 0.18.1 supplies the fonts. Excalifont, Virgil, Assistant, Lilita, Nunito, Cascadia and Xiaolai use SIL OFL 1.1; the full OFL text is in Cascadia-LICENSE.txt and Xiaolai-OFL.txt as well as Virgil metadata and Excalifont-source.txt. Comic Shanns uses the MIT text in its metadata. Liberation uses GPL v2 with the Liberation font exception (both texts included). Upstream font source: https://github.com/liberationfonts/liberation-1.7-fonts and https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/tree/v0.18.1/packages/excalidraw/fonts . These font licenses apply to the fonts, not to original Study Keys code.

SOURCES.json records source URLs. Font files are unmodified copies of the Excalidraw package files.
